title: Ku Na Ritshwa eNtshaveni
description: Thuli na vanghana va yena va rhandza ku tlanga “Ku Na Ritshwa eNtshaveni”. Kambe hi siku rin’wana ku humelela ndzilo wa ntiyiso kutani swimilani hinkwaswo leswo saseka entshaveni swi hundzuka nkuma. Thuli na vanghana va yena va ni gome … kukondza loko va vona swihluke switsongo swo thwuka na swa rihlaza. Xana swi nga va swi ri swa yini?
subjects: Nature and looking after our planet
